videos.title: Building the Stick Legions II V2.3 Update ⏩ (Made in Scratch)
videos.description:
Watch 353 blocks of new code go into Stick Legions II V2.3, block by block!

New in V2.3:
⚔ Gold Rush mode – all the gold in the middle
⛏ Mining Hustle and Bundle abilities
🃏 3-level card bar with equipment upgrade cards
🏰 Gate wall behind the statue

videos.title: Stick Legions II: Age of Wars – Version 2.3 Trailer
videos.description:
Stick Legions II, Version 2.3 is here!

• A gate wall behind your statue – your units march out through the gate
• Castle Archers shoot from the top of the wall
• Upgrade every unit: the card bar now has 3 levels
• Gold runs out! 50,000 gold in every mine
• New Miner abilities: Mining Hustle and Bundle
• Two spike walls – the second one goes behind the first
• New mode: GOLD RUSH – all the gold is in the middle
• War Elephants are now only for Carthage
